name: Applied Strategy and Organization: Strategies for international Corporations
description:
Professor Dr. Axel Stepken is the Chairman of the Board of Management of TÜV SÜD AG. The focus of his lecture is on understanding the necessary prerequisites and measures for the successful implementation of an internationalization strategy and transformation in the context of digitalization.

Relevant market-driven growth drivers, corporate strategies, corporate culture, concepts of complex organizations and leadership, as well as the impact of digitalization on business models, work-life balance, talent acquisition, knowledge management, organizational structure, and IT landscape will be discussed.

Professor Dr. Stepken will openly share his professional experiences with strategic and organizational challenges and present digitalization and its effects on international business activities.

Through independent study of academic literature, students will additionally acquire foundational knowledge in strategy planning and implementation on their own.
